incident_description: A pinhole leak due to localized external corrosion under damaged coating was discovered on 36-inch main line near MP 452. Line was immediately isolated and clamped. Zero ignition

site: ENTERPRISE PRODUCTS OPERATING LLC (MONT BELVIEU, TX
incident_description: High pressure ethylene release occurred at booster pump P-104 due to mechanical seal degradation. Hydrocarbon vapor ignited resulting in a flash fire. One maintenance technician suffered second degree burns and was hospitalized. PTW was active but seal flush line isolation had not been verified.
Overpressure event occurred during tank manifold switching operation. Pressure relief valve operated and released 80 barrels of crude oil into containment dike. No fire

Gasket blow-out on 12-inch station header flange caused 15 barrels of heavy crude release onto frozen ground. Emergency ESD button depressed by control room operator. Pressure dropped from 720 psig to zero within 90 seconds.

Storage tank overfill incident occurred during marine vessel offloading. Radar tank gauge stuck at 82% while high-high level alarm switch failed to actuate due to float mechanical seizure. Release contained entirely within secondary earthen dike.
High pressure gas regulator failed wide open at gate station custody transfer meter run
Third-party contractor operating backhoe snagged and severed an un-marked 4-inch steel natural gas main. Escaping high pressure gas migrated toward adjacent commercial building foundation and ignited

Low spot in crude gathering line developed internal pitting corrosion under stagnant sludge layer. Smart pig in-line inspection anomaly had been scheduled for repair within 60 days. Acoustic leak detection system notified SCADA dispatch of pressure rate-of-change.

During pig trap receiver door opening procedure, residual pressure of 45 psig remained trapped behind the barrel isolation gate valve. Crude spray struck the maintenance technician helmet and protective suit. Technician had not verified pressure bleed gauge prior to loosening rapid-opening closure clamps.

site: Trans Mountain Pipeline ULC - Trans Mountain Mainline - British Columbia
incident_description: A flange connection on the suction header of booster pump unit 2 developed a sudden spray leak at the Darfield pump station. Sump containment and oily water separator captured the released light crude oil. Control room shut down main line and dispatched emergency response crew.

site: Nova Gas Transmission Ltd. - NGTL System - Alberta
incident_description: Trenching machine operated by contractor struck a 10-inch lateral pipeline during tie-in activities on the Peace River section. The lateral had been marked with survey stakes but one-call ticket depth verification potholing was not completed prior to mechanical excavation.

site: Westcoast Energy Inc. - Fort Nelson Mainline - British Columbia
incident_description: Sour natural gas release occurred from a 1/2-inch instrument tubing fitting downstream of separator vessel V-12. Ambient H2S detection monitors alarmed at 10 ppm, triggering automatic facility ESD and deluge. Station personnel evacuated safely to designated muster points. Zero injuries.

site: Enbridge Pipelines (NW) Inc. - Norman Wells Pipeline - Northwest Territories
incident_description: Slope inclinometer detected accelerated thaw settlement ground movement on right-of-way kilometer post 142. Preventative line depressurization conducted after high bending strains observed. Minor seepage identified at girth weld during investigative bell hole excavation.

site: Alliance Pipeline Ltd. - Alliance Mainline - Saskatchewan
incident_description: Contractor crew performed hot work welding on support stanchion adjacent to glycol dehydrator without conducting atmospheric combustible gas testing. Flash fire occurred when fugitive vapors ignited. One contract welder sustained severe facial burns requiring airlift hospitalization.

site: Plains Midstream Canada ULC - Windsor to Sarnia Pipeline - Ontario
incident_description: NGL vapor leak detected at meter manifold packing gland during product batch changeover from propane to butane. Automatic gas detection initiated ESD, isolating valve manifold within 45 seconds. Perimeter flare ignited released vapor safely without damage to equipment.

site: Baghjan Oilfield Rig #5 - Oil India Limited - Assam
incident_description: Major uncontrolled blowout occurred during workover operations to test a deeper gas reservoir. The blow-out preventer (BOP) stack failed to seal around the workstring when high pressure gas surged from the producing sand. Secondary blowout prevention measures were compromised. Gas plume ignited into a major fire lasting several weeks. Two fire personnel sustained fatal injuries during emergency containment attempts.
hazard: High Pressure Inflammable Natural Gas & Condensate
barrier_failure: BOP Annular and Blind Ram sealing failure / Loss of primary hydrostatic well control barrier
consequence: Uncontrolled Well Blowout, Explosion, Fire, and Two Fatalities

precursor.barrier_failure: BOP Annular and Blind Ram sealing failure / Loss of primary hydrostatic well control barrier
precursor.hazard: High Pressure Inflammable Natural Gas & Condensate

site: Duliajan Gas Gathering Station (GCS-1) - Oil India Limited - Assam
activity: High Pressure Gas Manifold Valve Servicing
incident_description: During scheduled maintenance on gas manifold valve MV-102, crew removed bonnet studs while residual pressure of 48 kg/cm2 was trapped between the primary ball valve and check valve. High pressure gas escaping through the loosened bonnet ejected the valve assembly in the line of fire. One technician sustained fracture to right forearm. JSA had not specified physical line bleeding before unbolting.
hazard: Compressed Natural Gas under High Pressure
barrier_failure: Failure to depressurize and verify zero energy before breaking containment
consequence: Component Projectile Ejection, Loss of Containment, Severe Arm Fracture

precursor.barrier_failure: Failure to depressurize and verify zero energy before breaking containment

precursor.hazard: Compressed Natural Gas under High Pressure

site: Digboi Refinery Area - Crude Distillation Unit (CDU-II) - Indian Oil Corporation Ltd - Assam
activity: Hot Work Welding on Platform Handrail near Desalter
incident_description: Contract welders commenced structural grinding and tack welding on a mezzanine grating near the crude desalter vessel without checking local hydrocarbon drain sumps. Combustible gas detector had not been calibrated that morning. Sparks from grinding landed into an oily sewer opening containing volatile light naphtha vapors, igniting a flash fire. Two workers suffered 2nd-degree burn injuries.
barrier_failure: Absence of sewer covers and failure to perform mandatory continuous hot-work gas monitoring
consequence: Flash Fire in Process Unit, Burn Injuries

precursor.barrier_failure: Absence of sewer covers and failure to perform mandatory continuous hot-work gas monitoring
precursor.activity: Hot Work Welding on Platform Handrail near Desalter

site: Moran Production Station - Wellhead Manifold - Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) - Assam
incident_description: During hydrotest pressure buildup to 150 kg/cm2, a temporary test blind flange parted catastrophically due to incorrect grade bolts (commercial carbon steel used instead of alloy B7 studs). High pressure water and air jet whipped the test hose across the walkway. No workers were present in the designated barricaded exclusion zone. Zero injuries; test pump tripped immediately.
barrier_failure: Use of substandard fasteners / failure of QA inspection on test manifold blinds
consequence: Equipment Damage, High Pressure Hose Whipping, Potential SIF Near Miss

site: Jorhat Asset Field Compressor Station - Oil India Limited - Assam
incident_description: Overhead gantry crane was used to lift a 1.2 metric ton compressor cylinder head. The synthetic webbing sling was rigged over sharp unpadded cast-iron corners. Under load, the sling sheared through, dropping the cylinder head 1.8 meters onto the concrete maintenance bay deck. Two workers were standing 2 meters away outside the drop radius. Tag lines were not utilized.
energy_source: Gravitational Potential Energy (1.2 MT at 1.8m height)
barrier_failure: Failure to utilize sling corner softeners and failure to establish clear crane exclusion perimeter
consequence: Dropped Object, Concrete Floor Gouge, Near Miss SIF

precursor.barrier_failure: Failure to utilize sling corner softeners and failure to establish clear crane exclusion perimeter

site: LPG Bottling Plant Carousel Area - Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd - Maharashtra
incident_description: Technician reached beneath active chain conveyor to dislodge an empty 14.2 kg LPG cylinder without locking out electrical drive motor breaker. Co-worker pressed conveyor reset push-button from the opposite control console. Technician glove became entangled in sprocket teeth, resulting in partial amputation of right index fingertip.
barrier_failure: Failure to implement Lockout / Tagout (LOTO) and defeat of conveyor nip-point guarding

activity: Caught in running equipment or machinery involving Rotary table and drill pipe
incident_description: An employee was working on the rig floor assisting in tripping out drill pipe. The employee hand became caught between the hydraulic power tongs and drill pipe tool joint when the driller engaged the backup tong. The employee sustained a traumatic amputation of the left index fingertip and was hospitalized.

incident_description: An employee was assisting in pressure testing high pressure 2-inch treating iron to 9500 psi prior to hydraulic fracturing. A hammer union seal failed under pressure

activity: Fall from elevation to lower level involving Drilling rig monkey board
incident_description: A derrickman working on the monkey board 85 feet above the rig floor unhooked his fall protection lanyard from the inertia reel while attempting to align a stand of drill collars in the derrick fingers. The worker lost balance and fell approximately 18 feet onto the racking board railing. The worker sustained severe pelvic and femoral fractures and was hospitalized.
